title: MaxiMallAI envelope (Web UI <-> UE client)

request.description: Sent by the page with pixelStreaming.emitUIInteraction(obj). The UE client (owning AAwsTutorial_PlayerController) fills `selection` from the viewer's current planner selection before forwarding it to Server_ExecuteAiCommand. The page may leave selection out.

boothId.description: v2.0: salon booth in focus (stable level actor name, same on server and client): the booth whose configurator is open, else the nearest booth in view within 300 cm; empty = none

openBoothId.description: v2.0: booth whose configurator (right-click) is open, if any

inPlanner.description: v2.0: the requesting player is in «Конструктор»

result.description: Sent by the UE client with SendPixelStreamingResponse("MaxiMallAI:" + JSON). Exactly one per request.

reason.description: Russian, human readable; empty when ok. v2.5 §7: unchanged (compatibility) — the backend renders the visitor text in the session language from reasonCode + reasonParams.

reasonParams.description: v2.5 §7: only on refusals. `detail` (UPPER_SNAKE) names the exact template + numbers / ids (UE_REASON_CODES_v2.5.md). Also on refused check_fit candidates and enter_constructor result.carry.

state_rev.description: Server layout revision after the command (monotonic per planner instance)

event.description: Unsolicited UE -> page messages, same prefix `MaxiMallAI:`. v1.3: event 'ready' data = {username, plannerInstanceId} (CR-WEB-01). v2.0: 'planner_mode' data={inPlanner:boolean, view:'2D'|'3D'|null} on every planner open/close/view change (HUD or AI). 'booth_focus' data={boothId, productId, collection, label} when the focused salon booth changes (empty boothId = none).
m2.2 events: no state_rev (placement_result carries stateRev). Payloads: placement.schema.json#/$defs/event.

x-rules: Response prefix is exactly `MaxiMallAI:` followed by compact JSON; no second copy of the message.
The page times out a request after 8000 ms (capture: 20000 ms) and reports reasonCode TIMEOUT to the backend.
UE rejects more than 10 commands per second per controller with RATE_LIMITED.
